top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov rests on a complete, independently confirmed chain: proglucagon processing, identification of GLP-1(7-36) as the active glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide, its islet, gut and appetite actions, and outcome trials showing glycaemic, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The discovery is mature, well defined and decisive, and the citation scope on the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form fits a three-person allocation. No award is clearly inferior given the strength of this achievement.
